residual.instructions: Put it in the gray residual waste bin.

organic.instructions: Put it in the organic waste bin with the green lid.

paper.instructions: Put it in the paper and cardboard bin.

packaging.instructions: Empty the packaging and put it in the yellow sack.

glass.instructions: Empty the glass packaging and put it in the clear glass sack.

deposit.instructions: Return it to a store that accepts that deposit bottle.

electronics.instructions: Take it to a collection point for electrical and electronic devices.

batteries.instructions: Take it to a battery collection box at a store or to the Umweltmobil.

hazardous.instructions: Take it to the Umweltmobil. Check the county schedule for the next stop.

bulky.instructions: Arrange a bulky waste pickup with Landkreis Kusel.

landfill.instructions: Take it to the county waste facility at Schneeweiderhof. Check acceptance conditions before visiting.

green.instructions: Take it to a green waste collection point.

center.instructions: Check the facility’s accepted materials before visiting.

textiles.instructions: Pack it clean and dry and use an Alttextilien collection container.
